verdicts.reason: A: the venue line '6:00 pm until sundown, Harbour Rooftop, Pier 9' is the biggest text on the banner and crowds the left edge, so it outranks the 'Sunset Sessions' headline. The RSVP button is the same size as the FREE ENTRY pill, the logo is gone, and the reserve text on the right is too small to read. B has a better left-to-right order, with the headline in the centre and a clear RSVP CTA on the right. But a cropped, garbled text fragment ('ssions/presents') collides with the orange product graphic, the fine print under it can't be read, and the stacked pills are scattered, so B ends up slightly worse.
